name: Label
summary: The visible name of one control: a native label that focuses or toggles the control on click, with an optional required mark or optional text.
useWhen: A control outside a Field that needs a visible name: a Switch, a Checkbox or a Slider in a settings row
A small inspector control with a short name above or beside it, at size sm
Inside Field, which renders it as its label part through FieldLabel or the label prop
avoidWhen: A text control with a hint or an error message, where Field wires every id for you
A heading for a group of controls
A name for something that is not a form control

size.description: md is font.size.s, the label of a Field. sm is font.size.xs, for a small inspector control.

htmlFor.description: The id of the control. Not needed when the label wraps the control, or inside a Field.

required.description: Shows an aria-hidden asterisk. Outside a Field the word in requiredText joins the accessible name. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

requiredText.description: The word read after the label outside a Field. Default required, or مطلوب when the language is Arabic.

optional.description: Text after the label for a value that may stay empty, for example Optional. Never shown together with required.

disabled.description: Draws the label as disabled. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

invalid.description: Marks the label of an invalid control, for recipes. Draws nothing in the base. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

a11y.role: none: a native label element, which names the control it points at
a11y.focus: Never focusable. A click on it focuses a text control, or toggles a checkbox or a switch.
a11y.announce: Read as the control's name. The required mark is aria-hidden: inside a Field the control says required through aria-required, outside a Field a visually hidden word says it.
notes: No keys of its own: the control it names has the keyboard map.
Required is never a lone asterisk: the asterisk is a glyph that does not rely on color, plus aria-required on the control or the hidden word in the name.
Disabled keeps the words readable, in color.text.muted. The control carries opacity.disabled.
Radix Label keeps a double click on the label from selecting its text.

en.label: A noun in sentence case that names the value: Email, Board name. No colon, no question.
en.optional: Optional, in sentence case. Mark the few optional fields, or the few required ones, never both in one form.
en.required: Mark required fields with * and say once, above the form, that fields marked * are required.

ar.label: اسم بدون تشكيل يوصف القيمة: البريد الإلكتروني، اسم اللوحة. بدون نقطتين وبدون سؤال
ar.required: سطر واحد فوق النموذج: الحقول اللي عليها * مطلوبة

react.note: No motion: nothing on a label moves or fades, so there is no pattern to name and nothing to reduce.

angular.note: The host label is the root. Inside dsField the directive reads the field ids and state.

native.behavior: react-native:Text with nativeID, named by accessibilityLabelledBy on the control
native.note: A press on the text focuses or toggles the control.

styles.studio: Semibold text in color.text.default, the mark and the optional text in color.text.muted
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: A red asterisk as the only sign of a required control
mistakes.right: required on Label or Field: an aria-hidden glyph plus the word or aria-required

mistakes.wrong: A Label with no htmlFor next to a control that has no id
mistakes.right: htmlFor pointing at the control's id, or the control inside a Field

mistakes.wrong: A Label used as a section heading
mistakes.right: A heading element, or Fieldset with its legend for a group of controls

mistakes.wrong: A placeholder instead of a Label
mistakes.right: A visible Label, and an example value in the placeholder at most

mistakes.wrong: required on a Label outside a Field and aria-required on its control
mistakes.right: One of the two: the hidden word already says required, so the state would be read twice
